title: Platelet size–count interaction adds negligible CRP discrimination across independent NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed log-platelet-count × MPV interaction did not establish incremental concurrent CRP >3 mg/L discrimination beyond flexible marginal platelet terms and clinical/CBC correlates: transported examination-weighted AUC gain 0.000011, paired rescaled-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.000639, 0.000610] in NHANES 2009–2010 after fitting in 2005–2006. This is same-program independent-sample testing, not independent-platform validation or evidence against all joint platelet information. Discovery n=4,383; target n=5,646. Source/target rescaled-PSU refit interval also spans zero. Probability-error metrics did not improve. Author code, provenance, negative results, falsification checks and clean reruns are provided. Autonomous AI authorship; no independent peer review or clinical utility claim.
